# Design tokens

The design tokens of this project live in `tokens/` (DTCG JSON, managed with DTA); `dta build` writes them to CSS custom properties and Tailwind theme files. In code, use the tokens below instead of raw colours, sizes or fonts.

Do not invent token names. To find the token for a value, run `dta token find '<value>'`; to check one, `dta token get <name>`.

## Brands and themes

Built: `BrandA`, `BrandB`. Load `output/css/variables.css` and the theme files `output/css/themes/<brand>.css`, then switch with the attribute on any element:

```html
<html data-brand="branda">
```

Attribute values: `branda`, `brandb`.

## Collections

| Collection | Modes | Tokens | Use in code |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Brand(Alias) | BrandA, BrandB | 11 | yes |
| Primitives | Value | 26 | no: primitives, reached through aliases |
| ScreenType | Desktop, Mobile, Tablet | 5 | not in the build output |

## Rules

- In components, use the tokens above (semantic tokens), never primitives or raw values.
- Do not edit the build output or this file; change the token files and run `dta lint`, `dta build` and `dta diff --tokens-only`.
- Tokens in `Brand(Alias)`, `ScreenType` are aliases only: point them at another token, never a raw value.
- Every name segment in `Brand(Alias)` matches `^[A-Z][A-Za-z ]*$`.
- Text and background pairs keep a contrast of at least 4.5:1:
  - `Colors.Text.Default` on `Colors.Surface.Default`
  - `Colors.Text.On Primary` on `Colors.Brand.Primary`
  - `Colors.Text.Muted` on `Colors.Surface.Muted`
